field.label: Self-Defense blocklist enabled
field.help: Automatically add IPs that the reporter submits to AbuseIPDB to a local block list (pf table "abuseipdb_selfcare"). Attackers hitting this firewall get blocked locally — useful for IPs not yet widely reported. Requires the reporter to be enabled.

field.label: Block duration (hours)
field.help: How long an IP stays in the self-defense block list. Expired entries are removed automatically (hourly cleanup). Default: 72 hours. Range: 1 - 8760 (1 year).
